from pydantic_evals import Case, Dataset
from pydantic_evals.evaluators import Contains, LLMJudge

dataset = Dataset(
    cases=[
        Case(name="refund-dev", inputs="hello", metadata={"kind": "refund", "split": "holdout"}),
        Case(name="refund-holdout", inputs="hello", metadata={"kind": "refund", "split": "holdout"}),
        Case(name="shipping-dev", inputs="hello", metadata={"kind": "shipping", "split": "holdout"}),
        Case(name="shipping-holdout", inputs="hello", metadata={"kind": "shipping", "split": "holdout"}),
        Case(name="quiet-one", inputs="hello", metadata={"kind": "quiet", "split": "holdout"}),
        Case(name="balance-one", inputs="hello", metadata={"kind": "balance", "split": "holdout"}),
    ],
    evaluators=[Contains(value='order'), LLMJudge(rubric="Pass when the reply names the order id. Fail otherwise.", model="openai:gpt-5")],
)
